name: Certificate expiry report
summary: List the TLS certificates of vCenter, every ESXi host and extra endpoints with days to expiry.
description: Read-only. The portal server opens a TLS connection to vCenter, every ESXi host and the optional endpoints (port 443 unless given) and reads the presented certificate: subject, issuer, expiry, thumbprint. Status EXPIRING / CRITICAL / EXPIRED follows the warning days and operations.certificates.criticalDays; unreachable endpoints are listed as ERROR.

inputs.name: AdditionalEndpoints
inputs.label: Additional endpoints
inputs.help: One host or host:port per line (maximum 50). Port 443 when omitted.
